title: IEEE 802.15.4/MiWi-P2PStar: Fix ineffective reported length check
description:
tvb_reported_length_remaining returns an int currently, but cannot
be less than 0. At one point long ago, it (or precursors/related
functions like tvb_captured_length_remaining/tvb_length_remaining)
returned -1 if the offset was strictly outside the reported length,
but now 0 is returned (which makes more sense in most cases.)

So this test has been doing nothing. The only reason the test existed
in the first place is likely because of various "if (tree)" statements
in the previous function that essentially disabled bounds checking when
the tree is null but saved little. Remove those.

AI-Assisted: no
